title: Truckee River Rafting
specs: 5 miles float with 5 sets of mild rapids, last set most challenging
At least two paddling adults over age 16 per raft
Life jackets must be US Coast Guard approved if brought by guest
Pregnant women and elderly are not advised to raft
Rafts hold 4, 6, or 8 persons; only your party per raft
Dogs allowed if under 50 lbs and on leash
includes: Life jackets for everyone in the boat (children 12 and under must wear at all times)
Shuttle transportation back to your car after the float
gap: Maximum weight per person or raft not stated
blurb: Guests float down the Truckee River in commercial-grade rafts, enjoying scenic meadows, mountain views, and mild rapids. The trip is 5 miles long and takes about 2-3 hours. Shuttle transportation back to the launch point is included.
extraNote: Cancel 24 hours in advance for full refund of deposits · Reschedule up to 2 hours prior to departure with no deposit forfeiture · No refund for cancellations or no-shows within 2 hours of departure · Strict 24-hour cancellation policy · 175 River Road, Tahoe City, CA 96145, look for bright yellow flags and the Riverman logo
